build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a gap puzzle with a slope, ball, and container
create_convex_polygon_slope: create a convex polygon slope using C.add_convex_polygon with randomized vertex coordinates
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the PHYRE scene using C.add with center_x and center_y
add_container_goal: add a container goal using vt.add_container with goal segments and flip_lr parameter
update_task_relationship: update the task goal using C.update_task to require the ball touching the container
